test_title: PYST 27: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 23 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e143dc3e7b41300956a591f31e4664510555cfbb242c17f9f04ba8132e11f69.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**From figure 1 to 2, and figure 3 to 4:**

Top 2 symbols are interchanging their position with each other.

Bottom-middle and right-middle letters are interchanging their position with each other.

Middle-left, middle and bottom-right letters are shifting their position in clockwise direction.

**From figure 2 to 3, and figure 4 to 5:**

Top 2 elements and middle-left elements are shifting their position in anticlockwise direction.

Remaining all 4 letters are shifting their position in clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5edf377072221b2c43221370cf039b809014021138c38b85f08a4fc58d67481.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
